sample_ID_namespace: Original study animal laboratory IDs; no horse-name or registry crosswalk
raw_row_count_discrepancy_cause: Not resolved; original downloaded file checksum matches ENA. No claim of exact original-paper preprocessing reproduction.
G_definition: VanRaden method 1: ZZ^T / sum(2p(1-p)); cohort-observed allele frequencies; mean-impute missing dosage after QC

independent_numeric_verification.method: Independent VCF locus-by-locus frequencies and eight-sample outer products

limits: The 370-animal study is a selected sample with relatives, not all Japanese horses.
Genomic G is relative to the sampled allele frequencies, not absolute pedigree A or an IBD probability.
Negative G is below the current sample baseline, not proof of unrelated ancestry.
No pedigree classes or inbreeding are assigned from G cutoffs or its diagonal.
50kb spacing is not statistical LD pruning.
Odd-even autosome sensitivity is moderate; nearest-relative rankings are not invariant to marker partition.
No join to Meisho names, JRA/NAR horse IDs, or the existing Wikipedia horse cohort.
No race phenotype was used and no future racing predictive improvement is claimed.
